---
title: Source notes
---

`lt_note()` adds an unnumbered note to the footer, below any footnotes. It is the place for sources and caveats; add as many as you like, and wrap text in `I()` for raw HTML.

```{r}
library(lt)
lt(head(mtcars[, 1:4], 3)) |>
  lt_note("Data from the 1974 Motor Trend US magazine.") |>
  lt_note(I("<em>mpg</em>: miles per gallon."))
```
